export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page for '3M INDIA LIMITED' (48-51, Electronics City, Hosur Road) shows 53,522 shipment rows, but every visible row is an INBOUND record, e.g. "2026-02-28 | MEGUIARS INC | 3M INDIA LIMITED | ... | Savannah, UNITED STATES -> CHENNAI SEA INMAA1, India | 34059090 | BOL 7795718". No outbound (India -> foreign destination) row with date, destination, HS and B/L was visible in the free view. Source counter: page claims 53,522 records; rows actually seen = 5, all imports. A separate ImportKey page for '3M INDIA LTD' (Moraiya, Ahmedabad) showed 5 US-origin import rows (KUKDO CHEMICAL epoxy resin, HS 290007, B/L SEL32C891200W, 2022-06-12). No export B/L found.
domestic_evidence: Screener.in (BSE: 523395 / NSE: 3MINDIA) consolidated P&L: "Mar 2024 ... Sales 4,189" and "TTM 4,186" (Rs crore), with quarterly sales "Jun 2024 1,047" — i.e. large domestic turnover on record. Screener company note: "In India, the Company has manufacturing facilities at Ahmedabad, Bangalore, Pune and has an R&D Center in Bangalore." GSTIN-level turnover band and GeM/CPPP tender rows were not retrieved (search tool unavailable, GeM/CPPP not queried), so the GST band is null.
note: Legal entity exists and is listed (BSE 523395, NSE 3MINDIA); market cap Rs 31,776 Cr per Screener — no rejection grounds. Declared HS 854420 (insulated electric conductors/energy) does not match the shipment lines actually observed (34059090 polishes, 34025000 cleaning preparations, 39199090 self-adhesive film, 68042210 abrasive wheels) — per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; the company stays in the base and the HS code should be corrected to the actual traded codes. Export side: no outbound customs/B-L record was visible in free sources (volza, eximpedia, trademo, importgenius all returned HTTP 403 / JS challenge), so export is 'declared_only' — the company is a large importer and part of a global 3M network, but I found no dated India-origin export shipment to quote. Domestic supply is confirmed by audited-scale turnover (Rs 4,189 Cr FY2024 consolidated) and four Indian plants. Revenue: Rs 4,189 Cr FY2024 (Screener). Export volume: null (not public in accessible sources). GST turnover band: null. Web search tool was down (searx connection refused) during this run, limiting second-source coverage.
